planning_caveat: Historical SD used for design precision only; not a stationarity result for the current screen.

blinding_context.inspected: progress/file existence only; no V, T, psi, drift or voltage outcomes inspected

information_inspected: Only progress, source/config/code hashes, initial-state and RNG identity, solver counts and unit-test fixtures. No current-screen V/T/psi trajectories, means, voltage drops, or drift estimates inspected.
reason: Avoid an underpowered N=2 drift-equivalence selection bottleneck using historical variance, before outcome unblinding.
allocation: All three fixed gamma values at both fixed primary endpoints, eight fresh seeds, regardless of v1 screening verdict.
confidence_rules: Each gamma-versus-baseline claim is conjunctive. One-sided fraction/improvement/deltaV bounds at alpha=.025; original two-sided95% drift-equivalence intervals retained. Intervals are not advertised as jointly simultaneous across all constituents.
estimand: Arithmetic mean of seedwise fractions (Vlow-Vhigh)/Vlow; paired seedwise candidate fraction minus baseline fraction. Not ratio of means.
missing_run_policy: All48x10 required; no exclusions or imputation. Missing/error output disables success and selection.
winner_rule: Among candidates meeting every criterion: largest paired-improvement lower bound, then larger mean fraction, then gamma38.
scope: Confirmation under prospectively amended v2 design; v1 screen verdict remains separately reported. Endpoint comparisons do not establish curve shape or a continuous stationary branch.
